description: This file defines the ServiceSemaphore class in the org.apache.ofbiz.service.semaphore package. It manages locking mechanisms for services using a database-backed semaphore system, providing methods to acquire and release locks with different modes like wait or fail. The class interacts with the database, manages transactions, and provides synchronization to ensure only one thread holds the lock at a time.

classes.name: ServiceSemaphore
classes.description: A final class managing service lock semaphores using database records; supports acquire and release operations with modes for waiting or failing.

methods.name: ServiceSemaphore
methods.description: Constructor initializing the semaphore with a delegator and model, setting the mode based on configuration.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the semaphore lock, with support for waiting or failing based on the mode.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the semaphore lock if held.

methods.name: waitOrFail
methods.description: Handles waiting for the lock or failing based on semaphore mode, with timeout handling.

methods.name: checkLockNeedToWait
methods.description: Checks if the semaphore lock already exists; if not, tries to create it, otherwise indicates need to wait.

methods.name: dbWrite
methods.description: Manages database operations to create or remove the semaphore lock record within a transaction, ensuring exclusivity.
